findings.description: The Lambda environment contains a hardcoded AWS access key ID and secret access key. Lambda environment variables are accessible to principals permitted to read the function configuration and can be exposed through code, logs, or configuration access, allowing misuse of the embedded credentials.

The function uses the deprecated nodejs12.x runtime, which is no longer supported and does not receive current runtime security patches. This increases exposure to known vulnerabilities in the managed runtime.
